premise.situation: A self checkout machine says unexpected item in the bagging area and a person freezes
premise.turn: They begin performing honesty for a machine and for a staff member who is not watching
premise.detail: they hold the item up in the air as evidence

character_sheet: a man in his thirties, rain jacket, holding a shopping basket

beats.text: The self checkout said unexpected item in the bagging area.
And I froze. Completely. Like I had been caught.
I held the item up in the air. For the machine to see.
There is no camera. I know there is no camera. I did it anyway.
Then I looked around for the staff member, to show her I was innocent.
She was not looking. She has never once been looking.
I apologised out loud. To nobody. And then I paid for everything.
